name: casse-robot
description: Prototype de jeu de robots en blocs destructibles (Babylon.js + Rapier)

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p src/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p src/server/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.server: vite build --ssr src/server/main.ts --outDir dist-server --emptyOutDir && node dist-server/main.js
scripts.map:check: npm run map:build && node dist-tools/cli.js check
scripts.map:terrain: npm run map:build && node dist-tools/cli.js terrain
scripts.map:example: npm run map:build && node dist-tools/cli.js example
scripts.schemas: vite build --ssr tools/schemas/build.ts --outDir dist-tools/schemas --emptyOutDir --logLevel warn && node dist-tools/schemas/build.js
